# Keep the legacy new-mail alert titlebar change scoped to that document

The 1961049 patch removes customtitlebar="true" only from the legacy new-mail alert document. The current full document retains the alert window type, stylesheet/script loads and alert role without that attribute. The historical author reports a Windows grey area disappears and no Linux difference, but native attribute consumers and rendering were not exercised here. This source fact does not define a titlebar rule for other windows. Bug comment6 is unavailable, so there is no full-audit credit.

Scope: Legacy new-mail alert document.
